answer: Anchor the entire identity set's Merkle root to an external settlement chain each epoch: one timestamped summit no local validator can quietly re-carve. To backdate a sybil clone an attacker must buy real outside gas to re-anchor a forged history, and the next honest commitment overwrites it like clean tide refilling a drained lagoon. Such forgeries erode as fast as groundwater dissolves karst. Every fake needs its own paid re-anchor, so a farm of 1000 clones pays 1000 separate external-fee commitments, strictly linear, none recoverable, nothing amortized across the swarm.
